module: Pure (stateless) rules describing a player's "presence" relative to a vehicle: driver, passenger or unrestricted. Tells whether an input action map is allowed for a given mode and which unseated mode to use by default. No hook or state: it is used as a library.
usage:
local policy = require("gameplay/vehiclePresencePolicy")
if policy.allowsActionMap(mode, "driving") then ... end
notes: allowsActionMap: unrestricted allows everything; driver only allows the "driving" map; passenger allows nothing.
The file is loaded with require("gameplay/vehiclePresencePolicy"); the extension name gameplay_vehiclePresencePolicy is not necessarily loaded by extensions.load.

isValidMode.desc: Tests whether a value is a known mode.

returns.desc: true for driver, passenger or unrestricted.

normalizeMode.desc: Returns the mode if valid, otherwise the fallback mode if valid, otherwise "passenger".

defaultUnseatedMode.desc: Default mode of an unseated player: "unrestricted" in freeroam (or without a mode) when multiseat is not active, "passenger" otherwise.

allowsActionMap.desc: Indicates whether an action map is allowed for the mode.
